newsitem.title: UK: EMTA recommends early Thurs close, no trade Friday.
newsitem.headline: EMTA recommends early Thurs close, no trade Friday.

text.p: The Emerging Markets Traders Association (EMTA) recommended that the emerging debt markets in the U.S. should remain open for business until 1400 EDT/1800 GMT on Thursday July 3, and should be closed on Friday, July 4.
Dealers in London said they expected this to have a knock-on effect on activity on Friday with the U.S. Independence Day holiday putting a cap on trade. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7718
